authority_scope: Exact unclamped linear composite R geometry under the STE-identity convention. The sampled gains are deterministic matrix evaluations, not a shift-invariant approximation and not a score claim. Saturation, uint8 amplitude feasibility, and the frozen SegNet Jacobian are outside this passband.

operator.vertical: D_v = B_bilinear(874->384, align_corners=False) @ C_bicubic(384->874, align_corners=False, A=-0.75)
operator.horizontal: D_h = B_bilinear(1164->512, align_corners=False) @ C_bicubic(512->1164, align_corners=False, A=-0.75)

tangent_normal_anisotropy.law: For a local unit tangent t=(t_v,t_h) and normal n=(-t_h,t_v), evaluate G(f*t_v,f*t_h) and G(-f*t_h,f*t_v). Anisotropy is orientation- and frequency-dependent through the exact separable factors.
tangent_normal_anisotropy.interpretation: The pure R-chain x/y anisotropy is below 0.056 percent at the sampled Nyquist endpoint. It cannot explain the separate 3.2x lane-dash along-tangent representation deficit.

measured_along_tangent_anchor.scope: Representation/basis support deficit on the cited lane-dash probe, not R-chain attenuation or an admission verdict.
measured_along_tangent_anchor.followup: The later frequency-ladder probe did not confirm a simple raise-frequency cure and favored a comb-like interpretation; the family remains formulation-scoped.

uint8_role: uint8 clipping/rounding changes realizable amplitude and is deliberately excluded from this linear frequency response; it must be checked by a separate lattice readback.
